wga.name: Weighted Gradient Ascent (WGA)
wga.qualification: The pinned forget2.py omits the trainer's required strategy argument. For the selected wga_kl loss, it also only enables the reference on uppercase KL or lowercase npo matches.

npo.qualification: Freeze the native variant, reference and question/answer export. Verify the local TOFU-format split, model configuration and nonzero optimizer steps.

rmu.qualification: Blocked at the pinned command. The loader selects fixed dataset sources and cannot read the local StereoSet corpus.

biasunlearn.qualification: Excluded by study decision. Joint training and adaptive domain selection define this method. Preserve the original source for reference and omit this arm from single-domain execution.

ethos.qualification: Qualify the registered base, training view, original two-branch trainer and SVD checkpoint in the model-specific environment. Original Transformers 4.30.0 was incompatible with the modern architectures.
